title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer (USA)

• … du Dinge lieber selbst machst, als sie abzugeben und jemanden dabei besser zu machen.

• … du unangenehme Gespräche aufschiebst. Ein Teil dieser Rolle besteht daraus.

Benefits

• Ein Team, das dir gehört - und die Freiheit, es zu formen.

• Klarheit über deinen eigenen Weg: Wir haben eine ausformulierte Level-Matrix. Du siehst schwarz auf weiß, was auf deinem Level erwartet wird und was der nächste Schritt ist.

description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication - particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) - remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic-electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) is a field data collection company founded in 2017 in Europe.

Participants will listen to recorded audio conversations and accurately transcribe them into text following project guidelines. The work involves understanding spoken language, identifying speech patterns, and ensuring high transcription quality.

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As GTM Narrative Lead at Anthropic, you will be the keeper of Anthropic's company story for customers. You will own the company narrative presentation end to end and keep it current as models and products ship, shaping how customers first hear who Anthropic is, what Claude changes for them, and why we are the right partner.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role in Solutions & Segment Marketing, within Enterprise Marketing. You will shape the storyline with senior leaders and write the words, the script, and the deck yourself. You will work closely with Product Marketing, Product, Research, Sales, Enablement, Brand, Design, and Communications to translate complex AI capabilities into compelling stories that resonate with enterprise buyers and reflect Anthropic's commitment to developing AI systems that are safe, steerable, and beneficial.

What you'll be shaping

Your narrative will be the starting point for customer conversations across executives, sellers, partners, and events. Each model and product launch changes what customers can do, and you will work directly with the people building it to turn it into a story a CEO can act on.

You will also set up how the work gets done: the customer-insight loop, the measures, and the Claude workflows that keep a story current at this pace. This role offers the opportunity to shape how one of the world's leading AI companies tells its story at a pivotal moment in the industry's development, while ensuring our narrative reflects our commitment to responsible AI deployment and societal benefit.

Key responsibilities

•
Own the company narrative: Own Anthropic's company narrative presentation from start to finish, including the storyline, the master deck, speaker notes, and the versions used by executives, sales, partners, and events

•
Translate capabilities into customer outcomes: Turn complex research and product capabilities into a clear story about what changes for customers, what it's worth, and why Anthropic is the right partner

•
Keep the story current through every launch: Lead the narrative update for every major launch, so the story is refreshed, approved, and in the hands of the field on launch day

•
Build and run a customer-insight loop: Use win/loss reviews, call recordings, executive briefings, customer advisory input, and usage data to keep testing and adjusting the storyline

•
Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner with Product Marketing, Brand, Design, and Communications to keep the company narrative aligned with positioning, messaging, and external voice

•
Measure whether the narrative works: Define and report on how widely the deck is used, how often key messages show up in deals, and feedback from customers and executives

•
Build workflows with Claude: Speed up research, customer feedback summaries, drafting, and versioning

Product marketing, corporate marketing, or portfolio marketing background, with a track record of personally writing a company or portfolio-level narrative for B2B software products

Recent, hands-on writing of the master deck for executives and sellers, including speaker notes and audience versions

Proven ability to turn technical capabilities into customer outcomes for C-level and business buyers

Experience leading narrative updates for major launches on short timelines, through review and into the field

•
Experience building a customer-insight loop (win/loss, call recordings, briefings, usage data) and changing the story because of it

•
Experience measuring narrative use and impact, and reporting it to leadership
